chat.author: Deb Cooley
chat.text: we can!

chat.author: Justin Richer
chat.text: and we'll have a joint WIMSE/OAuth meeting as well

chat.author: Justin Richer
chat.text: at the next IETF

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text: Good point, Justin.

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text: Lots of progress since the last IETF meeting

chat.author: Pieter Kasselman
chat.text: Mission shaping feels conceptually a bit like  like translating a search query into results....

chat.author: Yaron Zehavi
chat.text: Is authority_set a ceiling? If so the client / shaper needs to request upfront all resources and RARs

chat.author: Pieter Kasselman
chat.text: Or need a mechanism to ask for more midway through (probably need that regardless)

chat.author: Justin Richer
chat.text: yeah, step up is going to be necessary for this to be mature but I think it can run/start without that, similar to both scopes and RAR. The failure state is to "do oauth"

chat.author: Pieter Kasselman
chat.text: Revocation probably needs to be available not just toAlice, but to any number of actors who are authroised to cancel a mission...

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text: A gap in revocation was mentioned in previous presentations

chat.author: Justin Richer
chat.text: Does this account for user->user delegation? I don't think it does at this level.

chat.author: Justin Richer
chat.text: @pieter or do you mean mechanical actors here?

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text: There also seem to be similar proposals: this work talks about "mission" whereas others talk about "intent"

chat.author: Pieter Kasselman
chat.text: The seperation between intent and mission is helpfull in my view

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text: I am not sure

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text: Maybe something to discuss

chat.author: Hannes Tschofenig
chat.text: Slide 46 is very helpful to me

chat.author: Pieter Kasselman
chat.text:
@pieter or do you mean mechanical actors here?

I can imagine a risk management system observing patterns and missions being exoecuted and intervening when a mission is going sideways, or no longer needed. Basically automated intervention - since people can't keep up with these decisions.

chat.author: Brian Campbell
chat.text: following on Pieter's point about people being overwhelmed, I certainly am

chat.author: Brian Campbell
chat.text: "hope is a waking dream"

chat.author: Maxwell Gerber
chat.text: Thanks!
